review_basis: Direct inspection of all three original-resolution 20-mass PNG boards after recursive geometry synthesis, BOOK mutation, program hard gates, and same-source legal/FAR/parking evaluation.

neighborhood.measured: 20/20, 19 BOOK operations, 13 visual-language keys, six p.3 scopes, zero near-duplicate silhouette pairs; curved 1, oblique 2, prismatic 2, stepped 5, voided 5, winged 5.
neighborhood.visual_verdict: Street bar, courtyard, terrace, calm block, split wing and curved edge alternatives coexist. No single wedge, gable or terrace family dominates the board.
neighborhood.remaining_limit: The board is a massing-language portfolio; storefront rhythm, circulation, structure and facade resolution are not evaluated.

gymnasium.measured: 20/20, 18 BOOK operations, 11 visual-language keys, six p.3 scopes, zero near-duplicate silhouette pairs; curved 4, oblique 1, prismatic 5, stepped 2, voided 4, winged 4.
gymnasium.visual_verdict: Long-span bars remain programmatically legible while calm halls, curved sections, courts, split/service bodies, stepped sections and one oblique form are visibly distinct.
gymnasium.remaining_limit: Roof structure, clear span, spectator/service circulation and daylight performance still require downstream architectural analysis.

cultural.measured: 20/20, 17 BOOK operations, 17 visual-language keys, six p.3 scopes, zero near-duplicate silhouette pairs; curved 3, oblique 3, prismatic 2, stepped 4, voided 5, winged 3.
cultural.visual_verdict: Courts, paired galleries, carved entries, curved connectors, stepped civic masses and tapered/oblique gestures coexist without one low-box family taking over.
cultural.remaining_limit: Gallery sequence, art-handling logistics, structural grids and facade/public-realm quality remain outside this diagnostic.

cross_program_verdict: The three programs are measurably and visibly different: gym has the longest mean oriented plan aspect ratio (2.1086), neighborhood has the strongest street/court/wing mixture, and cultural has the richest visual-language count (17) and highest mean legal geometry retention (0.9321).
verdict: The recursive Geometry Language and selector now pass the requested procedural mass-diversity diagnostic and same-source hard constraints. This is not evidence that the alternatives are competition-ready buildings; architecture-grade claims remain prohibited until site planning, circulation, structure, facade and performance are evaluated.
